Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
Urinalysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, nitrites, and positive urine culture for >100,000 CFU/mL Klebsiella pneumoniae, consistent with a urinary tract infection. Presence of hematuria and low specific gravity are noted. Glucosuria is abnormal and may warrant further evaluation for hyperglycemia or renal glycosuria. No ketones or casts detected. Recommend clinical correlation and appropriate antimicrobial therapy.
